title: German Bundestag Lets Customs Freeze Crypto Over €100,000 Without a Criminal Case as the Bill Goes to the Bundesrat
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

German Bundestag Lets Customs Freeze Crypto Over €100,000 Without a Criminal Case as the Bill Goes to the Bundesrat
The Bundestag approved a bill that would let German customs freeze crypto and other assets over €100,000 of unclear origin without a criminal case. Permanent confisca...
content:
The German Bundestag on Thursday approved a government bill that would let customs freeze cryptocurrency and other assets worth more than €100,000 when their lawful origin appears implausible, without first opening a criminal case. Permanent confiscation would still take a finance-court judgment. The measure still needs the Bundesrat’s consent before a planned Jan. 1, 2027 start, and the timing of that upper-house vote remains unclear.

The Bundestag passed the Customs Financial Justice Act, a Finance Ministry overhaul to strengthen the customs administration and fight financial crime, on Nov. 12. The federal government introduced the bill on Sept. 30. The Finance Committee recommended passage on Nov. 11, with the Christian Democrats, Social Democrats and Alternative for Germany in favor, The Left opposed and the Greens abstaining.

Crypto is covered but not singled out

Crypto is covered expressly, using the European Union’s Markets in Crypto-Assets definition, but it is not singled out. The same administrative procedure applies to cash, cars, real estate and other property. It reaches only “significant” assets: generally those worth more than €100,000, or more than €50,000 if the asset must be entered in a public register, such as vehicles or land. Because crypto is not registered that way, the €100,000 threshold applies. Customs may estimate the value, and closely related items can be treated as one asset.

Customs offices — not Germany’s Financial Intelligence Unit, which the same bill strengthens separately — may freeze those assets for up to 30 days without a criminal case if there are factual indications the origin is not lawful, meaning lawful acquisition “does not appear plausible.” A finance court may extend that hold once by 150 days. That extension is decided by a single judge, without a hearing, in an order that cannot be appealed. Filing a confiscation application stops the clock until the court rules, so the often-cited 180-day period is not a hard cap.

Permanent confiscation still requires a finance-court panel to be convinced the origin is unlawful. The committee shifted that decision away from a single judge. Owners must be told they are not required to produce records, and anything they do provide may be used in tax and criminal cases. The official justification says mere silence, or a denial of knowledge, will as a rule not be enough to prevent confiscation.

Supporters and critics split

Finance Minister Lars Klingbeil said in August that if suspects cannot show assets were legally acquired, “the Porsche or the Rolex are gone for now.” In Thursday’s debate, Social Democrat Ingo Vogel told the Bundestag that criminally acquired assets do not enjoy constitutional property protection, and that the bill is “no automatic confiscation” and “no blanket reversal of the burden of proof.”

The Bundesrat, in an earlier comment, had asked for a true burden-of-proof reversal and for the court extension to run up to 12 months, citing, among other things, “crypto concealment structures.” The government refused the fuller reversal and did not adopt the longer hold in the bill the Bundestag approved.

Germany’s Federal Bar Association opposes the bill, warning that vague terms and missing paperwork, including for inherited assets, should not be treated as proof of illegality. The German Bar Association also rejected the government draft. The Blockchain Bundesverband, commenting on the ministry draft, said the law needed to distinguish custodial, self-custodied and decentralized arrangements, because with a self-custodied wallet control “regularly lies with the holder of the private key,” and state access then exists only through measures against the person, not through third parties. The bill itself is silent on how, or whether, customs could take self-custodied keys. A freeze of crypto would be carried out by attachment under the Tax Code.

The government expects about €308 million a year in extra revenue from 2028 from the procedure as a whole, not from crypto alone. The Greens argued that figure is a sliver of Germany’s estimated €100 billion annual money-laundering volume.

The new power is separate from an earlier criminal case. In 2024, Saxony’s prosecutors, with the Federal Criminal Police Office, sold about 49,858 bitcoin from the Movie2k case between June 19 and July 12, for €2.64 billion. That sale was an emergency liquidation in a criminal proceeding, not an exercise of the administrative tool the Bundestag has now approved.

Micah Zimmerman

Micah first discovered Bitcoin in 2018 but remained a skeptic on the sidelines for too long. Since 2021, he has covered crypto and business and now works as a news reporter for Bitcoin Magazine, based in North Carolina.

title: Lighter Halts Withdrawals and Pool Creation After Security Incident Triggers Urgent Probe
summary:
Key Takeaways: Due to a possible security breach, Lighter has temporarily paused all withdrawals and pool creation. The exchange suspects that it may be a case of one compromised external
The post Lighter Halts Withdrawals and Pool Creation After Security Incident Triggers Urgent Probe appeared firs...
content:
Key Takeaways:

  • Due to a possible security breach, Lighter has temporarily paused all withdrawals and pool creation.
  • The exchange suspects that it may be a case of one compromised external party.
  • The investigation continues and full impact and cause still remains to be determined.

Decentralized exchange Lighter has temporarily restricted two key platform operations while investigating a security incident. The move is being made to pinpoint what has been compromised and whether the platform’s users or infrastructure might be impacted.

  • Lighter Confirms Security Investigation
  • Withdrawals and Pool Creation Temporarily Suspended
    • No Timeline for Restoring Operations
    • Investigation Continues as Lighter Assesses the Damage

Lighter Confirms Security Investigation

According to Lighter, in a statement published on its official Twitter/X account on Nov. 16, it is actively working on one incident that was suspected to have been caused by a single external party that has been compromised.

We are actively investigating a security incident that appears to involve a single compromised external party.

As a precaution, we have temporarily suspended all withdrawals and pool creation while we investigate the circumstances and assess the full impact.

— Lighter (@Lighter_xyz) November 16, 2026

The exchange did not specify the type of third party or describe how the compromise came about. It also stated in its original announcement that it’s not releasing figures for impacted accounts nor giving an estimate of possible losses.

The discussion doesn’t seem to be about a flaw in the Lighter protocol; it appears Lighter is studying a security threat by an outside party instead. Yet practically nothing is known of the incident at the platform for establishing a definite source.

Read More: Bitget Halts Withdrawals After $351.6M Hot Wallet Incident Hits Crypto Exchange

Withdrawals and Pool Creation Temporarily Suspended

To ensure the security of its users, Lighter has clarified that it temporarily will halt all withdrawals and pool creation.

The surround-out takes place because of these restrictions so that potential exposure will be reduced during the investigation. During the pause on withdrawals, users will not be able to withdraw funds from the platform and during a pause on the creation of liquidity pools, users will not be able to create new liquidity pools in this period prior to the security review.

Lighter said that the measures are to be in effect as ongoing investigations into the situation and the extent of the damage are carried out.

No Timeline for Restoring Operations

Withdrawals and pool creation were not scheduled till they still were announced. Lighter gave no explicit indication if there had been any impact on existing liquidity pools, trading or balances of individual users.

The user consequently receives only minimal official details about the incident, apart from temporary restrictions and the fact that it is suspected that the incident was caused by an external party.

Investigation Continues as Lighter Assesses the Damage

The pending Lighter update will play a crucial role in resolving the issues of whether the attack was a mere third-party compromise or a vulnerability in the way that external accounts are interacting with the platform.

Any reports citing a method of attack, hit accounts or overall damage are preliminary until the exchange releases additional technical data. For the time being, Lighter’s focus is on getting pertinent details about the incident, determining the scope of possible exposure and recovery before restoring the suspended services.

title: XRP Price Prediction: Ali Martinez Identifies $0.78 Bottom as XRP’s 2017 Ascending Triangle Takes Shape
summary: XRP is facing renewed selling pressure below the $1 threshold, while crypto analyst Ali Martinez has identified a potential long-term support level near $0.78 that could influence its next market cycle.
content:
Skip to content
Assets: XRP

XRP is facing renewed selling pressure below the $1 threshold, while crypto analyst Ali Martinez has identified a potential long-term support level near $0.78 that could influence its next market cycle.

In his latest technical analysis, Martinez highlighted an ascending triangle that has been developing on XRP’s weekly chart since 2017. The structure points to a possible recovery toward $3.50 resistance, with a longer-term upside target of $18 if the cryptocurrency eventually confirms a breakout.

Ali Martinez Identifies $0.78 as a Potential XRP Bottom

Martinez’s analysis focuses on a multi-year ascending triangle, a technical formation characterized by rising support and relatively horizontal resistance. The pattern suggests that buyers have gradually established higher support levels while the price has repeatedly encountered selling pressure near a similar resistance zone.

XRP’s long-term ascending triangle points to a potential correction toward rising support at $0.78, following a 43% decline from its October high of $1.55. Source: Ali Martinez via X

According to Martinez, XRP could revisit the pattern’s rising trendline near $0.78 before attempting a sustained recovery. He identified the level as a potential area of renewed demand, stating, “That’s where I would expect buyers to step in.”

The projection comes as XRP trades around $0.95 on November 16, following a prolonged decline from its October high near $1.55. The token recently fell below the psychological $1 level, reaching an intraday low around $0.89 on November 14 before recovering toward $0.97 the following day.

A decline toward $0.78 would represent another considerable correction from current levels. However, Martinez’s analysis suggests that such a move would not necessarily invalidate the broader ascending structure. Instead, the rising trendline could serve as a longer-term support area where buyers attempt to establish a price floor.

The $0.78 level remains a technical projection rather than a confirmed bottom. Its significance will depend on how XRP responds if the price approaches that region and whether buying activity increases enough to prevent a deeper breakdown.

XRP Price Prediction: $3.50 Breakout Could Open the Path Toward $18

Beyond the potential support zone, Martinez identified approximately $3.50 as the horizontal resistance level of the multi-year ascending triangle.

A recovery toward this area would require XRP to regain several intermediate resistance levels and establish stronger upward momentum. More importantly, the analyst’s bullish scenario depends on a confirmed weekly breakout above $3.50, followed by a successful retest of that level as support.

A confirmed breakout above $3.50 could open the way toward an $18 target in a future bull phase. Source: Ali Martinez via X

Such a development would provide stronger technical evidence that the long-term ascending triangle is resolving to the upside. A successful retest would also indicate that buyers are willing to defend the former resistance zone after a breakout.

Martinez projects that a confirmed breakout could eventually place XRP on a path toward $18. This represents a substantial long-term target compared with the current price, but it remains conditional on several technical developments.

The $18 projection should therefore be viewed as a possible extension of the bullish chart structure rather than an immediate price expectation. XRP would first need to recover from its current downturn, approach the $3.50 resistance area, and establish a sustained weekly breakout.

Until those conditions develop, the ascending triangle remains an analytical framework rather than confirmation of a new bullish cycle.

XRP Open Interest Falls as Traders Reduce Bearish Positions

Derivatives positioning is also drawing attention as XRP moves sideways following its weekend decline. Crypto analyst CW8900 reported a rapid contraction in open interest across XRP perpetual futures contracts, with both long and short positions declining.

XRP futures open interest is declining as both longs and shorts unwind, with short positions closing faster amid sideways price action. Source: @CW8900/X

The analyst noted that short positions were closing at a faster rate than long positions. This suggests that some traders who had positioned for further losses were reducing their exposure around current price levels.

A reduction in short positions can ease immediate selling pressure, particularly when traders close bearish contracts by buying back the underlying exposure. However, declining open interest does not automatically indicate an upcoming price reversal.

Market data provides a more mixed picture. XRP’s aggregate futures open interest stood near $1.96 billion on November 16, down approximately 2% over 24 hours, according to CoinGlass. The platform also showed negative funding, indicating that short-position holders were paying long-position holders to maintain their contracts.

Meanwhile, recent liquidation figures indicate that bullish traders have also faced substantial pressure. Long liquidations exceeded short liquidations by approximately $44 million across Binance, Bybit and OKX on November 14, according to figures cited by CCN.

These developments point to a broader reduction in leveraged market exposure. Although faster short closures could provide temporary support, a sustained XRP recovery would require stronger spot buying demand and renewed participation from market buyers.

XRP Technical Indicators Keep the Downtrend in Focus

XRP’s broader technical outlook remains under pressure despite signs that selling conditions may be becoming stretched.

Investing.com’s November 16 technical snapshot showed a strong sell reading across its daily indicators and moving averages. All 12 tracked moving-average signals, covering periods from five to 200 days, indicated selling pressure.

XRP price chart. Source: Brave New Coin

The 14-day Relative Strength Index stood near 43.7, below the neutral 50 threshold but above the traditional oversold level of 30. The Williams %R indicator, however, registered approximately -93.8, indicating an oversold condition.

This mixed oscillator picture suggests that some short-term measures are registering stretched selling conditions, while broader momentum has yet to establish a convincing recovery signal.

Price levels also provide a framework for monitoring the next XRP move. Classic pivot calculations place nearby support around $0.936 and $0.924. A sustained move below these areas could expose the recent swing low near $0.89.

On the upside, resistance appears around $0.976 and $0.988, followed by the psychological $1 level. Reclaiming this region would be an initial step toward improving the short-term technical structure, although additional resistance remains across the longer-term moving averages.

For now, XRP’s price prediction depends on whether buyers can defend nearby support and gradually restore upward momentum. Martinez’s $0.78 projection offers a longer-term downside reference, while $3.50 remains the key breakout threshold in his bullish scenario.

A weekly close above that resistance, followed by a successful retest, would strengthen the case for the projected $18 target. Without that confirmation, the broader downtrend and weakening derivatives participation remain important considerations for XRP traders.

title: GODO Advances from Introducing Broker to Full UAE Dealing Licensee
summary:
Brokerage group GODO has secured a Category 1 licence from the UAE Capital Market Authority (CMA), advancing from an onshore introducing agent into a fully authorised local dealing entity.
GODO have announced the licence following initial approval in August and the completion of the regulator's rema...
content:
2026-11-16T18:03:00.000+02:00

Monday, 16/11/2026 | 16:03 GMT by Tanya Chepkova

  • GODO has obtained a UAE Category 1 licence for GODO Securities, adding a locally licensed dealing company to its business.
  • Its existing Category 5 company will continue introducing clients to third-party providers; GODO has not given a launch date for the new service.

Brokerage group GODO has secured a Category 1 licence from the UAE Capital Market Authority (CMA), advancing from an onshore introducing agent into a fully authorised local dealing entity.

GODO have announced the licence following initial approval in August and the completion of the regulator's remaining requirements. The new authorisation is for GODO Securities which is a separate company from the UAE entity which has been the representative of the brand up until now.

From Client Introductions to Brokerage

GODO Introduction Financial Services L.L.C. holds a Category 5 licence (number 20200000168). Under its regulatory disclosure it is an introducing firm and brings clients to regulated third party providers.

The third party providers open the accounts and enter into the contracts with the clients, while the introducing firm does not execute the trades or hold the client's assets.

GODO Securities gives the brand a different role. Category 1 is the CMA's dealing in securities category under which a firm can be authorised for brokerage activity.

The approval doesn't in any way alter the licence that GODO Introduction Financial Services already holds as the two companies have separate regulatory authorisations.

UAE Approval Follows Cyprus Licence

The approval comes as part of GODO's foray into another regulated market this year. In May CySEC licensed GODO Capital Ltd in Cyprus to receive, transmit and execute client orders on behalf of clients for approved financial instruments. Apart from that the company is registered as a Mauritius investment dealer company.

The immediate effect of the licence for GODO's UAE business is that it now has a dealing company in addition to the firm that brings clients to other providers. The next stage is to actually start using that licence. The company has not yet said when GODO Securities will be commencing to serve clients or what products it will be offering.

title: Networking With an Impact: The FM Summits Legacy
summary:

Money Ready, a UK financial education charity, i...
content:
2026-11-16T18:00:00.000+02:00

Monday, 16/11/2026 | 16:00 GMT by Finance Magnates

  • Introducing the Money Ready and One Tree Planted initiatives within the FM Summit London Impact & Legacy programme.

The connections made at Finance Magnates Summit London 2026 can have an impact beyond commercial outcomes. Through the FM Summits Impact & Legacy programme, the summit brings attention to practical initiatives that extend outside the conference floor.

Money Ready, a UK financial education charity, is part of the Opening Networking Blitz on 23 November at The Folly, attendees can meet the team and hear how they help people build financial confidence.

Giving is optional and open to everyone, with donations going directly to Money Ready.

Their display will remain at the venue across both Summit days, with donations handled directly by the charity. The programme also includes One Tree Planted, with a tree associated with each sponsor and exhibitor.

Discover the Summit and its wider programme at https://events.financemagnates.com/events/fmsummitlondon/networking-blitz

The value of a major industry gathering should not end when delegates leave the venue. Through the FM Summits Impact & Legacy programme, this year’s edition brings community initiatives into the wider event experience, encouraging the industry to consider the positive contribution it can make beyond business discussions.

At the Opening Networking Blitz on 23 November, the Summit will highlight Money Ready, a UK charity focused on financial education. Attendees will have the opportunity to learn about its work and support the charity directly. The programme also includes an environmental initiative with One Tree Planted, whereby one tree is associated with each sponsor and exhibitor as part of the event's legacy activity.

These initiatives connect naturally to the people convening in London. Financial education is closely related to the industry's expertise, while environmental action creates a tangible commitment linked to participation. The objective is to make room for community impact alongside the Summit's commercial and professional priorities, without suggesting that attendance alone resolves broader social or environmental challenges.

The Impact & Legacy programme extends the Summit beyond its commercial agenda. At the Opening Networking Blitz, Money Ready brings attention to financial education, while the event’s wider One Tree Planted initiative connects sponsor and exhibitor participation with an environmental contribution.

These initiatives sit alongside, rather than replace, the business purpose of the event. Delegates can support the charitable activity while using the 23 November gathering to reconnect with peers before continuing into a full day of industry discussion and exhibition meetings on 24 November.

In addition to security features, this OKX review will illuminate some basic information about OKX and provide information to answer the following questions: Where is OKX based? What are OKX supported and restricted countries? What are OKX trading fees?

OKX crypto exchange also runs its own blockchain, the X-layer blockchain network, and a native token, OKB. This native token is used to pay trading fees, reward investors for holding OKB through OKX earn programs and grant users access to voting and governance on the trading platform.

OKX is based in Seychelles, but its global presence extends far beyond that. As a provider of crypto exchange and Web3 services, OKX operates offices in key locations worldwide, including Hong Kong, Singapore, the UAE, Silicon Valley, and the Bahamas, ensuring comprehensive support for its users worldwide.

OKX supports cryptocurrency trading in over 100 countries, including South Africa, Singapore, Kenya, Australia, the Netherlands, Argentina, and Seychelles. Its broad reach ensures a seamless trading experience for users across diverse regions worldwide.

No, OKX exchange is not available in the US. However, they offer Web3 services to US users.

What are OKX Restricted Countries?

OKX exchange has some partially restricted countries, while others are prohibited completely. Users in countries that are not fully restricted have limited access to the platform’s services. Some of them include:

  • Belgium, Japan, Malaysia, and Cuba: Users in these locations are restricted from using margin and derivatives-related services, including futures, perpetual, and options trading.
  • Canada: Existing users can access OKX, but new OKX  account registrations are not allowed at the time we write this review.
  • Hong Kong: The company’s derivatives services are unavailable in Hong Kong.
  • The United Kingdom, the Bahamas, and the Netherlands: These countries are prohibited from using the platform’s derivatives-related services.

Note: Potential users from most of these countries cannot currently register on OKX. Only existing traders can use the permitted products and services on OKX.

OKX Completely Restricted Countries

OKX crypto trading exchange is unavailable to traders in the United States and its territories, Belgium, France, Iran, Cuba, Bangladesh, North Korea, Bolivia, Malta, Crimea, Syria, Donetsk and Luhansk regions, and Ireland.

The company might update the list of restricted countries as regulations in those locations evolve. If you are interested in using their services, regularly check for updates or, better still, explore other alternatives.

What are OKX Trading Fees?

OKX trading fees are based on the market taker and maker model like many other exchanges. OKX exchange has low trading fees, starting at 0.10% for takers and 0.08% for makers, and higher VIP-level traders will pay lower fees than this standard.

The maker is the trader who created a limit order to sell their crypto. Because this order is not filled immediately, some exchanges, including OKX, charge them lower fees because they add liquidity to the platform. On the flip side, the taker picks up an existing order or purchases the crypto the maker sells from the order book. These traders want their orders filled immediately, thereby taking liquidity away from the platform.

For example, if the current ETH lowest ask price is 2,700 USDT and you create a maker order with a bid price of 2570 USDT, this order cannot be filled immediately. OKX will enter it into the order book until someone (a taker) fills it.

Here is a rundown of the fees for spot, futures, options, and spreads trading on the OKX crypto exchange.

1. Spot Trading Fees

OKX charges regular users 0.10% for takers and 0.08% for makers. The spot interface allows users to buy or sell crypto immediately or when the particular coin reaches a specific price, depending on whether they choose a market or limit order.

Since the platform uses a tiered rating that depends on traders’ 30-day trading volume and the number of OKB tokens the traders hold, transaction fees can be discounted to 0%.

Note: The above fees are for USDT pairs. OKX charges less fees for crypto, other stablecoins, and fiat pairs depending on users’ 30-day trading volume.

2. Futures Trading Fees

For futures contracts, OKX charges;

  • Taker Fee: 0.05% for non-VIP users.
  • Maker Fee: 0.02% for non-VIP users.

The fees are lower for VIP users, with VIP 1 users paying 0.03% (taker) and 0.01% (maker) for futures. The image below summarizes the fees for various VIP levels by trading volume or amount of OKB token the user is holding.

3. Options Trading Fees

OKX transaction fees for options start at 0.02% for makers and 0.03% for takers, and the options fees are calculated differently, even though trading volume is also an important factor here. OKX also charges a forced liquidation fee and an exercise fee, which is not applicable if you initiate a 1-day options that doesn’t expire on Friday.

4. Spreads Trading Fees

A 50% discount applies to the standard fee rate for all users on spread trading fees. So, if you are VIP 1 opening a BTC/USDT-margined perpetual spread, the transaction fee will be 0.04% for makers and 0.05 for takers.

What are the Best Features of OKX Crypto Exchange?

The best features of OKX are the OKX trading bot, OKX copy trading, OKX wallet, and OKX mobile app. Here’s a rundown of these features and how they ensure a smooth trading experience for beginners and advanced traders alike.

OKX Trading Bot

The trading platform offers about 11 bots to help users automate their trades and earn even when they are inactive. The grids include spot and futures grid, futures DCA, smart arbitrage, spot DCA (martingale), recurring buy, signal bot, iceberg, TWAP, smart portfolio, and arbitrage.

Here is a breakdown of how some of these bots help you earn more without constantly monitoring your trades.

  1. Spot Grid

The Spot grid mode splits your starting funds between the two digital assets of your chosen trading pair, say BTC/USDT. The bot then creates a grid of price points between the upper and lower limits and divides your capital equally between the number of grids used.

The bot automatically buys more of the asset when the price drops to a lower grid level. Then, when the price rises to an upper grid level, the spot grid bot automatically sells some of the assets.

Each time the price reaches the upper grid line, the bot automatically sells a portion of the asset and buys the traded asset when the price reaches the lower grid line. You make money from the difference between the prices at which the bot buys and sells.

  1. Futures Grid

The futures grid aims to make money from price fluctuations within a range. OKX offers various types of futures grid strategies:

  • Long Futures Grid: The bot buys futures at the current price and sells them when the price rises. This strategy is best for markets that are expected to go up but still have some volatility.
  • Short Futures Grid: The bot sells futures at the current price and buys them back when the price drops. This strategy is best for markets that expect to go down but still have some volatility.
  • Neutral Futures Grid: The bot trades in both directions, buying when the price is low and selling when it’s high, no matter the market trend.

The goal of the futures grid is to earn small profits from each price movement, whether the market is going up or down or staying within a range.

  1. Smart Arbitrage

OKX smart arbitrage helps traders make steady profits while reducing the risk of price changes in the market. It uses a Delta-neutral strategy, which means holding equal but opposite positions in two markets:

  • Buying a cryptocurrency in the spot market (long position).
  • Selling the same cryptocurrency in the perpetual swap market (short position).

This bot helps balance gains and losses, so price changes have less impact, and profits come from funding fees earned during the holding period. There are two types of smart arbitrage strategies on OKX:

  • Custom Mode: You choose your strategy and set profit targets.
  • Smart Mode: The system recommends the best strategy and automatically manages profit-taking, stop-loss, and adjustments.

Unlike smart arbitrage, there are four ways to set up the OKX futures and spot bots. You can either set the parameters based on your analysis, fill in parameters recommended by the crypto trading bot, use AI strategy, or copy lead traders’ winning bots.

OKX Copy Trading

OKX copy trading is a program that allows new users to copy strategies from more advanced traders and automatically execute them in the spot or futures markets. When you copy a seasoned trader, you will imitate their trades and automatically open and close positions when the trader you copy opens or closes theirs.

Transaction fees for the trades users copy are usually the same as the regular fees for the user’s tier level. However, you will need to share your profit with the lead trader, usually about 8 – 13% of your results. Additionally, you can set a maximum amount per order and a maximum amount for the trader you are copying.

For instance, you can set your maximum amount per order at 50 USDT and your maximum amount for the trader at 500 USDT.  After the lead trader has opened 10 positions, you will have an invested margin of 500 USDT, which is your maximum limit. So, if the trader opens an eleventh position, you won’t copy them.

OKX Wallet

OKX Wallet is now one of the best-decentralized wallets on the market. It supports many blockchain networks and enables users to access and explore the Web3 world. Unlike the OKXX exchange, with the OKX wallet, you have full control of your assets and private keys because the wallet is entirely decentralized and non-custodial.

The OKX Web3 wallet is designed to provide a full-fledged and seamless Web3 experience. It has a built-in DEX aggregator for multi-chain and cross-chain transactions, so you can switch between supported networks instead of creating multiple wallets on various chains.

Additionally, you can engage in yield farming, go through the NFT marketplace, and explore over 1,000 DApp protocols. Now, here are the benefits of using the OKX web3 wallet:

  • Gives you full control and ownership of your assets and wallet.
  • Quick crypto withdrawals without an approval process, unlike crypto exchanges.
  • Multi-chain wallet that automatically recognizes and connects to different blockchain technology networks without requiring manual user switching.
  • Manage crypto assets on over 60 chains, including Ethereum, Aptos, Optimism, and BSC.
  • Available on iOS, Android, and web browsers.

Remember that the OKX Web3 wallet does not save your seed phrase, private key, or password; you are responsible for these.

OKX Mobile App

OKX offers a mobile app with a user-friendly interface for buying, selling, trading, and managing crypto even when you are on the move. Unlike the desktop interface, the OKX app provides a simple and clean view, perfect for beginners, and an advanced mode for more experienced traders.

The OKX app is available on Apple Store and Play Store, and the registration process is straightforward. While the mobile app version is faster and more user-friendly, it still has all the tools available on the web interface and everything you need to manage your digital assets.

With a few taps, you can easily buy, sell, and convert crypto using fiat or other crypto assets, even though fiat withdrawals may not be as smooth as crypto withdrawals. Users can also explore the various trading options, set limits, and market orders with TP/SL, trail stops, etc., as you would do in the desktop version.

In addition, the OKX app offers margin trading with leverage of up to 10X. For derivatives, its futures contracts and perpetual swaps have leverage up to 125X, and you can set alerts to receive notifications when specific changes occur in your trades.

How to Open New Account and Trade on OKX?

Follow these steps to open an account and trade on OKX.

Step 1: Select your country or region and agree to the terms and privacy agreement, then click “Next.”

Step 2: Use your email to register and add the OKX referral code “CNJREVIEW.”

Step 3: OKX will email you a verification code. Once you add the code, it’s time to verify your number. They will send you another code via text.

Step 4: Create a secure password to protect your OKX account. We recommend creating at least a 12-word long password.

Step 5: Verify your identity by completing the KYC verification process. OKX will verify your documents within 24 hours.

To start trading crypto on OKX, follow the following steps:

Step 1: Deposit Funds

You need to fund your OKX account to begin cryptocurrency trading on OKX. You can deposit cryptocurrency from another wallet or use fiat options like credit cards (Visa, Mastercard), bank transfers, or peer-to-peer (P2P) transactions.

If you want to deposit crypto, go to the ‘Assets’ tab and select ‘Deposit.’ Choose the cryptocurrency and the network you want to deposit. Then, transfer the cryptocurrency to the generated wallet address.

Step 2: Choose Your Trading Method

Go to the ‘Trade’ section to see the various trading options OKX crypto exchange offers. Depending on the kind of trade you want to do, choose between spot or derivatives (futures, margin, and perpetual swaps).

For beginners, starting with the spot market or using the copy trading tool to imitate experienced traders is advisable.

Step 3: Place Your First Trade

Select the pair you want from the spot or futures market, like PEPE/USDT or BTC/USDT. Since this is your first trade, we recommend you use a small amount of money to trade.

Use the order window on the right to place buy or sell orders. You can choose between different order types:

  • Market Orders: Execute immediately at current prices.
  • Limit Orders: Set a specific price you want to buy or sell crypto.
  • Stop Orders: Execute when a certain price condition is met.

Finally, confirm your order, and it will be executed according to the order types you choose.

Does OKX Require KYC?

Yes, OKX does require KYC. The process is similar to that of other exchanges. To confirm your identity, you must submit personal identification documents, such as a selfie, a passport, or a driver’s license. Ensure that the information on your ID matches the region/country you picked during the account registration process.

Is OKX Safe and Legit to Trade Crypto and Bitcoin?

OKX is safe and legitimate to trade crypto and Bitcoin. The platform is considered as one of the best cryptocurrency exchanges with the cleanest interfaces. It is designed with simple and advanced modes to cater to various users. Additionally, if you are a beginner, the mobile app is better for learning, and you don’t have to worry about missing anything because it has all the features on the desktop version.

OKX offers some security features, including offline asset storage, a risk shield, multi-factor authentication, passkeys, anti-phishing codes, and withdrawal address whitelisting.

  1. Cold Wallet Storage

95% of assets on OKX are stored in offline wallets, which are not susceptible to hacks and security breaches. The company limits how much cryptocurrency can be stored in a single cold wallet address to further protect user funds assets stored offline.

Each address can hold a maximum of 1,000 BTC. This spreads the total amount of offline assets across multiple wallets, preventing a single point of failure. Once the funds in one cold wallet are withdrawn, new deposits will no longer be received.

  1. OKX Risk Shield

OKX crypto exchange sets aside a percentage of the platform’s assets, over $700 million, to safeguard money and users from potential breaches. The risk fund is similar to Binance’s Secure Asset Fund for Users (SAFU), which protects against security breaches and market volatility.

3. Multi-factor Authentication

Once you open an account on OKX, it is important to up your security. You can do this through the profile icon. There, you will find various security measures to activate.

Start with two-factor authentication (2FA), then activate passkeys and authenticators. If you decide to activate the Google Authenticator app, keep the code you will be given safely. If you lose your phone or change devices, you can use it to log in to your authenticator app.

4. Anti-phishing Codes

This security feature allows users to double-proof their account security. When you activate it, OKX will email you a code that helps you differentiate between legitimate communications and suspicious emails.

5. Proof of Reserves

OKX published their December 2024 proof of reserve data and they’re holding over USD 30.8 billion in reserves. This includes some of the most popular cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin (105%), Ethereum (102%), and stablecoins such as Tether USDT (106%) and USD Coin (100%).

The PoR is published monthly, and the company uses advanced cryptographic methods, including zero-knowledge proofs, to ensure full transparency while protecting user privacy. You can independently verify your assets through OKX’s dashboard and public wallet addresses.

6. Withdrawal Address Whitelisting

OKX allows users to choose which wallet addresses are allowed for withdrawals through the address whitelisting feature. Any address outside the pre-approved addresses will automatically be blocked. So, even if someone tries to hack into your account, they cannot move funds to any address since they are not on the list.

The exhibition at Finance Magnates Summit London 2026 brings the commercial side of the event into focus. Delegates can move from a conference discussion to a direct conversation with a company offering relevant technology, liquidity, brokerage services or market infrastructure. That combination makes the exhibition a practical part of planning a productive Summit day.

Participating brands include LMAX Group, ATFX Connect, Plus500, CMC Markets and Adaptive, alongside businesses serving different parts of the financial services ecosystem. Their presence gives attendees the chance to explore different approaches, ask specific questions and understand where products and services might fit their own business needs. Product teams can compare capabilities, commercial leaders can explore partnerships, and operations specialists can speak directly with providers about implementation requirements. The value of an exhibition is the ability to move beyond a product description. A direct conversation can help delegates ask about integration requirements, operating models, service coverage and the commercial implications of a potential partnership.

title: Exness launches Anthropic CFD following public market debut
summary:
Exness, a global multi-asset broker, is adding an Anthropic contract for difference (CFD) to its offering following the AI company’s public market debut. The instrument, ANT, will be available on Exness Terminal, MetaTrader 4 (MT4), and MetaTrader 5 (MT5).
This public listing gives traders access to...
content:
2026-11-16T15:43:19.317+02:00

Monday, 16/11/2026 | 13:43 GMT by Exness

Disclaimer

  • Exness clients can trade Anthropic price movements on Exness Terminal, MetaTrader 4, and MetaTrader 5.

Exness, a global multi-asset broker, is adding an Anthropic contract for difference (CFD) to its offering following the AI company’s public market debut. The instrument, ANT, will be available on Exness Terminal, MetaTrader 4 (MT4), and MetaTrader 5 (MT5).

This public listing gives traders access to the company behind Claude and direct exposure to the AI sector. It also puts the company’s performance in focus: how demand for its products translates into revenue and how it manages the costs of developing its technology.

“The central question about the AI boom is whether commercial growth justifies the scale of investment,” said Wael Makarem, Financial Markets Strategist Lead at Exness. “Markets will look for evidence that Anthropic’s revenue growth can lead to lasting profitability. Competition, computing costs, and the pace of adoption will all influence whether the company can meet those expectations.”

The Anthropic CFD lets clients trade share price movements without owning the underlying shares. CFD traders can find ANT on their preferred platform and review its specifications.

“Adding Anthropic reflects our focus on making relevant global market opportunities accessible to CFD traders,” said Igor Desyatov, Exness Deputy CEO & Chief Trading Officer. “For clients following the company’s public debut, access through the platforms they already use makes the instrument part of their existing trading environment. Our priority is to support that access with a reliable trading experience.”

The Anthropic addition expands Exness’ range of instruments, connecting its clients with price movements and sentiment as AI reshapes the technology sector.

About Exness

Founded in 2008, Exness is a technology-focused, multi-asset broker offering access to global financial markets through CFDs. Its product range includes forex, commodities, stocks, indices, and cryptocurrencies. Exness develops its own technology and trading tools, focusing on reliability and the client experience.

title: Why Guardrails Will Decide How Far AI Money Management Goes
summary: Picture handing a trading bot access to your savings. The first thing most people would want to know isn't its returns. It's what happens on the day it gets something badly wrong, and who can pull the plug. The IMF asked the institutional version of that in its April 2026 note on agentic payments, a...
content:
2026-11-16T15:20:52.705+02:00

Monday, 16/11/2026 | 13:20 GMT by FM

Disclaimer

  • AI money management needs strict guardrails and human accountability to succeed.

Picture handing a trading bot access to your savings. The first thing most people would want to know isn't its returns. It's what happens on the day it gets something badly wrong, and who can pull the plug. The IMF asked the institutional version of that in its April 2026 note on agentic payments, and its view is that agentic AI systems should not directly execute irreversible transactions without structural safeguards. That answer, more than any model benchmark, is what will decide whether people sign up.

What Happens When the Agent Is Wrong

Clicking approve on every action doesn't scale. The Bank of England's Deputy Governor Sarah Breeden made that point in June 2026, saying that relying on a human in the loop for every agent action is unlikely to be realistic. Anyone who's had to sign off on a dozen small things a day knows how that goes.

The alternative is to draw the line before the agent ever starts. Which accounts can it touch? How much can it put at risk? How fast can someone hit stop? The IMF adds a condition of its own, too: high-risk or high-value transactions should still need human approval or supervisory intervention.

Steven McWhirter, Global Head of Policy at Binance, puts the principle in one line, "Autonomy should never outrun our ability to verify, bound and, where necessary, revoke it."

That's three verbs, and what they add up to is a fence. Households understand fences. Nobody has to understand the model behind the agent to see where the edges are, in the same way a driver can find the brake pedal without knowing much about engines.

What Is Bounded Autonomy in AI Money Management?

Bounded autonomy means an agent works within clearly authorised objectives, permissions and limits, and runs into stronger safeguards as its ability to move value grows. Binance Global Policy's Steven McWhirter and Diego Montes Serralde set out the Know Your Agent framework in October 2026, and in it, bounded autonomy rests on three things: a verified agent identity, a defined mandate and an accountable human.

“When software can investigate, decide and move money, we need to be able to say with confidence which agent acted, on whose authority, and who remains accountable. Know Your Agent isn’t about giving software legal personality; it’s about preserving accountability as autonomy scales,” says McWhirter.

Binance's earlier paper on the agentic era comes at it from another angle. An agent's intelligence can be as sophisticated as you like, it argues, while its authority stays tied to fixed permissions, execution limits, runtime controls and revocation. And the KYA paper adds that as an agent gains authority to influence decisions and move value, governance should follow, with stronger requirements for identity, permissions, auditable conduct and revocation.

Binance AI Pro shows what that looks like in a product people can actually use. Live strategies run in a dedicated AI Strategy Account, a sub-account kept separate from the user's main account, and only the user can fund it, by manual transfer.

There's more. The agent can't move funds by itself, and strategy sub-accounts can't withdraw to external addresses. Users can pause a strategy, tweak it or kill it whenever they want. Changing the logic creates a new version that needs approval before it runs. And Binance's launch release says the design follows the paper's bounded-autonomy principles, under which agents analyse and recommend, and consequential actions always require explicit human approval.

Put next to the framework, it lines up nearly point for point. The separate account is the mandate. Manual funding keeps a human accountable. And revocation is the off switch.

Regulators are leaning the same way. Singapore's Monetary Authority announced its runtime-safeguards framework in July 2026, with a focus on validating actions before they happen. The UK's Financial Services AI Adoption Plan, published that same month, recommends Know Your Agent protocols. Both start from the assumption that an agent can be checked, and stopped, while it's acting.

Best MCP Servers for Connecting AI Agents to a Crypto Exchange?

The best MCP connections are the ones that bring the bounds along with them. A Model Context Protocol server is where an outside agent picks up its permissions on a trading venue, after all.

Binance's MCP server, part of its Agent OS platform, lets users put an agent in a dedicated subaccount, set its permissions and revoke access at any time. These are the same controls households need from a consumer product, just exposed to developers. An MCP connection without a subaccount, a permission scope or a quick way to revoke access is autonomy with no bounds at all. And since a venue can't see an outside agent's reasoning, the bounds are the only accountability it can actually enforce. Whoever sets the permissions decides how much autonomy the software really gets.

Trust at the Speed of Accountability

AI will change how people manage money about as fast as accountability allows, and no faster.

Households are far more likely to trust real balances to products that had bounds on autonomy from day one.

In every one of those, the off switch stays with the person whose money it is.

title: Bitcoin Price Today: BTC Loses $65K Support as CZ Weighs Anthropic IPO and ETF Outflows
summary: Bitcoin fell below $65,000 after a sharp selloff pushed BTC to $62,006, as ETF withdrawals, macroeconomic concerns, and weakening risk appetite weighed on market sentiment.
content:
Skip to content
Assets: BTC

Bitcoin fell below $65,000 after a sharp selloff pushed BTC to $62,006, as ETF withdrawals, macroeconomic concerns, and weakening risk appetite weighed on market sentiment.

Binance co-founder Changpeng Zhao, known as CZ, has outlined several possible explanations for the decline, including capital shifting toward Anthropic’s upcoming IPO, institutional withdrawals, and growing security concerns. However, he cautioned that no single factor has been established as the cause of the downturn.

Bitcoin Price Today Remains Under Pressure Below $65K

Bitcoin’s latest decline extended a difficult period for the cryptocurrency market. BTC dropped to approximately $62,006 on November 15, marking its lowest level in several months before recovering toward $64,500. The asset was trading around $64,581 in the latest TradingView snapshot, keeping it below the psychologically important $65,000 threshold.

Bitcoin (BTC) price chart. Source: Brave New Coin

The broader correction has also involved heavy selling across other digital assets. Bitcoin’s weekly losses approached 15% as selling pressure intensified. Meanwhile, approximately $750 million in Bitcoin positions were liquidated over a 24-hour period, with long positions accounting for nearly 80% of the total. These forced closures added to downward pressure as leveraged traders struggled to maintain their positions.

The latest price movement also reflects deteriorating market conditions beyond the cryptocurrency sector. Weak technology stocks, uncertainty surrounding interest rates, and reduced institutional demand have contributed to a broader shift away from risk-sensitive investments.

CZ Identifies Potential Reasons Behind the Crypto Selloff

CZ addressed the market downturn in a post on X, listing several developments that could be contributing to the decline. He began by highlighting the possibility that investors are moving capital toward Anthropic’s planned initial public offering (IPO).

CZ suggests Bitcoin’s decline to $62,006 may be partly driven by capital shifting toward Anthropic’s anticipated multibillion-dollar IPO. Source: @cz_binance via X

The artificial intelligence company is preparing an IPO that could raise up to $64.4 billion, with an estimated fully diluted valuation of approximately $1.4 trillion. Its shares are expected to begin trading on the Nasdaq on November 19 under the ticker ANT. The scale of the offering has attracted considerable investor attention, creating speculation that some capital could be shifting away from other assets ahead of the listing.

However, CZ avoided presenting the IPO as a confirmed explanation for Bitcoin’s weakness. He emphasized the uncertainty surrounding the market’s movements, stating, “No one knows for sure. Correlation does not prove causation.”

He also rejected speculation that Binance had been selling its cryptocurrency holdings. “No, Binance did not sell crypto,” CZ wrote, adding that he had personally purchased crypto over the previous few days after receiving stablecoins. He jokingly suggested that his own purchases might have contributed to the decline.

Despite the recent weakness, CZ maintained a positive long-term outlook, stating that crypto would continue to grow over the medium and long term.

Bitcoin ETF Outflows Add to Selling Pressure

Institutional demand has weakened alongside Bitcoin’s price decline. U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded approximately $1.91 billion in net outflows across seven consecutive trading sessions between November 5 and November 13, according to figures reported by crypto.news and The Block.

Bitcoin extended its weekend decline from $67,400 to a Sunday low of $61,946 before consolidating sideways in a potential bearish flag pattern on the 1-hour chart. Source: BASE78945 on TradingView

The withdrawals continued throughout the week. On November 13, the funds recorded another $185.4 million in net outflows. BlackRock’s iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) accounted for approximately $143.5 million, while Fidelity’s Wise Origin Bitcoin Fund (FBTC) recorded withdrawals of $41.9 million.

Ether investment products also experienced persistent withdrawals. U.S. spot Ether ETFs lost approximately $398.9 million during the week, extending their negative flow streak to seven consecutive weeks. The figures suggest that investors have reduced exposure to several cryptocurrency investment products rather than Bitcoin alone.

Leveraged trading activity has added another layer of pressure. According to CoinGlass, total cryptocurrency liquidations approached $1.96 billion over a rolling 24-hour period. Bitcoin accounted for roughly $750 million, with long positions representing approximately 80% of those liquidations.

These figures highlight how declining prices can trigger additional selling through forced position closures. However, ETF withdrawals and liquidations do not independently establish what initially prompted the broader market decline.

Anthropic IPO Revives Comparison With Bitcoin’s SpaceX Rally

The potential movement of investment capital toward Anthropic has also drawn attention to a historical comparison involving SpaceX’s public listing. Market commentator Matt Cole highlighted similarities between Bitcoin’s performance ahead of the two high-profile offerings.

Matt Cole highlights a similar pattern, noting Bitcoin’s 18% decline ahead of Anthropic’s planned $64 billion IPO mirrors its 19% drop before SpaceX’s June 2026 IPO. Source: @ColeMacro/X

Cole noted that Bitcoin declined approximately 19% during the 50 days preceding SpaceX’s June 2026 IPO, which raised $75 billion. The cryptocurrency has reportedly fallen around 18% over a similar period ahead of Anthropic’s planned listing.

The comparison attracted attention because Bitcoin’s performance changed considerably after the SpaceX offering. According to Cole’s analysis, BTC reached its lowest point 18 days after the listing, eventually recovering sharply. By the 100th day, Bitcoin had moved approximately 3.7% above its initial starting level.

From the SpaceX IPO closing price, Bitcoin gained roughly 28% over the following 100 days. Its recovery from the post-listing low reached approximately 39%.

Following the SpaceX IPO, Bitcoin bottomed 18 days after the listing before recovering, eventually trading above its pre-IPO level by Day 100. Source: Matt Cole via X

Cole suggested that a similar pattern could emerge following Anthropic’s listing, potentially indicating that much of the recent selling has already occurred. His analysis also places Bitcoin near its 200-week moving average, a technical reference that he considers relevant to the current market structure.

Nevertheless, the comparison remains a historical observation rather than evidence of an established market pattern. The SpaceX and Anthropic offerings involve different companies, market conditions, and investor expectations. Bitcoin’s previous recovery also does not guarantee a similar outcome in the coming months.

Security Concerns and U.S. Economic Uncertainty Weigh on Sentiment

CZ also pointed to several security incidents that could influence investors’ willingness to hold cryptocurrency. These included the October Binance attack, reports of iPhone-linked crypto wallets being drained, and a Chrome browser exploit.

The Binance incident was particularly significant. On October 31, the FBI attributed the theft of more than $6 billion in virtual assets from Binance on or around October 29 to North Korean actors associated with the TraderTraitor group. The agency reported that the attackers had primarily converted the stolen assets into Ether as part of their laundering activities.

Although the incident does not establish a direct link to Bitcoin’s latest decline, high-profile security breaches can raise concerns about the safety of digital assets and cryptocurrency infrastructure. Such developments may influence investor confidence, particularly during periods of broader market uncertainty.

Macroeconomic conditions have provided another potential source of pressure. October’s U.S. Consumer Price Index increased 0.4% after rising 0.6% in September, while core inflation advanced 0.3% during the month. The figures have kept attention on the Federal Reserve’s monetary policy outlook.

Expectations of another interest rate increase have also weighed on market sentiment. Higher borrowing costs and rising bond yields can reduce the appeal of speculative investments, while a stronger U.S. dollar may create additional headwinds for Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies.

Political uncertainty following the U.S. midterm elections has added to the concerns. CZ noted that investors may be assessing the possibility of stricter cryptocurrency policies in the country. Changes in the regulatory environment could influence institutional participation and broader market activity.

BTC Technical Outlook Remains Bearish Despite Oversold Signals

TradingView’s technical summary continues to indicate a sell bias for Bitcoin, reflecting the distance between its current price and the broader moving average structure.

At approximately $64,281, BTC remains below nearly all the moving averages in the provided technical snapshot. The 10-day exponential moving average stands near $70,716, while the 20-day EMA is around $73,890. Longer-term indicators also remain above the current price, with the 200-day EMA near $76,032 and the 200-day simple moving average at approximately $72,921.

The moving average summary records 13 sell signals, one neutral reading, and one buy signal. This indicates that the broader trend remains under pressure despite attempts to stabilize after the recent decline.

However, several momentum indicators are beginning to reflect oversold conditions. The Relative Strength Index (RSI) stands at 24, while the Stochastic %K is around 9 and the Williams Percent Range is approximately -84. These readings suggest that Bitcoin has experienced substantial selling over the measured periods and could attract short-term buying interest.

The oscillator summary is comparatively constructive, with six buy signals, four neutral readings, and one sell signal. Nevertheless, the MACD remains negative, indicating that underlying downside momentum has not yet reversed.

Bitcoin’s next price movements will likely depend on whether buyers can establish a sustained recovery above the $65,000 threshold and eventually reclaim nearby moving average resistance. Continued weakness could expose the market to another test of the recent $62,006 low.

For now, CZ’s comments highlight the difficulty of attributing Bitcoin’s decline to a single development. ETF withdrawals, macroeconomic uncertainty, security concerns, and changing investment preferences have all emerged as possible contributors. Whether the upcoming Anthropic IPO marks a turning point for market sentiment remains uncertain, while Bitcoin’s technical indicators continue to reflect a cautious near-term outlook.

The post BingX Review 2026: Is it Safe & Legit to Trade Crypto? appeared first on CryptoNinjas...
content:
BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange that offers spot, futures, and derivatives trading services. The platform is popular for its easy-to-use interface and social trading features that allow users to copy the trading strategies of experienced traders on the platform.

Additionally, they provide grid trading features and a P2P marketplace to over 10 million customers in more than 100 countries globally. However, there is more to this crypto trading platform.

So, in this BingX review, we will explore what BingX is, its best features, fees, safety and how to create an account. Let’s begin!

  • What is BingX?
    • What Are the Pros of BingX?
    • What Are the Cons of BingX?

  • Is BingX Safe and Legit for Trading?
  • How to Open an Account at BingX
    • Is KYC Mandatory on BingX?
    • What are the BingX Supported Countries?
      • Is Bingx Available in USA?
    • Does BingX Have Taxes?
    • What Are The Best Alternatives For BingX?

What is BingX?

BingX is a cryptocurrency exchange that offers multiple trading services and employs robust security measures, allowing traders to buy, sell, and trade digital assets with peace of mind.

The platform is most popular for offering copy trading services and social trading features that allow users to earn passive income. This is especially beneficial for traders who are unsure of their trading skills and would rather earn passive income with the assets.

Let’s look at BingX from a glance: here is a detailed summary of the trading platform, covering its founder, year of establishment, geographic restrictions, features, and more.  

Exchange BingX
Founded2018
Founder Josh Lu
Features
  • Spot Trading
  • Copy Trading
  • Grid trading bots
  • BingX Wealth, and 
  • P2P marketplace
Margin Trading Yes
Leverage Up to 150X
Trading Fees0.1% maker/taker for spot, 0.02% maker, and 0.05% taker for futures trading.
Know Your Customer (KYC) VerificationYes, optional
Security 
  • Two-factor authentication (2FA)
  • Anti-phishing code
  • Proof of reserves (PoR data)
  • Insurance fund
  • Secure sockets layer (SSL)
Supported Cryptocurrencies and Available Trading Pairs900+ cryptocurrencies and over 1000 trading pairs.
Accepted Payment MethodsCredit cards, Apple and Google Pay, bank transfers, and direct crypto deposits.
Device Compatibility Mobile and desktop.
Restricted Countries Saudi Arabia, United States, Netherlands, Iceland, New Zealand, China, Japan, Luxembourg, Bosnia, and Norway.

What Are the Pros of BingX?

BingX pros are:

  • Passive Income: BingX offers opportunities for users to earn passive income through the social trading service.
  • Simple Interface: The platform is simple and easy to use for beginners, and users can explore their trading account which has a standard TradingView.
  • Reliable in Terms of Compliance: BingX is available in over 100 countries, including Australia, Germany, and Russia.
  • Demo Trading: BingX offers a pre-funded trading simulator that allows you to practice trading without putting your money on the line. 
  • Copy Trading Feature: On BingX, you can choose to copy the trading strategies of experienced traders to maximize your profits. The platform has about 17,000 elite traders with detailed profile overviews to help you make the right choice.
  • Know Your Customer Verification: The KYC verification process is optional on BingX. In fact, there’s little difference between what verified and unverified users can do on the platform. The main difference is the withdrawal limits and discounts on trading fees.
  • BingX customer support is available 24/7.
  • Mandatory Test: To start trading derivatives on BingX, users must pass a specific test to ensure they don’t blow up their funds.
  • Supports 900+ Crypto and over 1000 Trading Pairs: BingX currently has a large selection of 925 cryptocurrencies and over 1204 trading pairs.

What Are the Cons of BingX?

BingX cons are:

  • No Leverage for Spot Trading: BingX does not offer leverage for spot trading, so you cannot amplify your trades to get better earnings. This is because using higher leverage can lead to higher rewards, though with higher associated risks.
  • High Withdrawal Fees: Withdrawal fees on BingX are relatively high compared to the market average. For instance, the cost of withdrawing USDT through ERC20 is higher than that of most exchanges. So, we do not recommend trading with small amounts on BingX to avoid giving up a chunk of your money to withdrawal fees.
  • No Fiat Money: BingX does not allow traders to directly exchange crypto for fiat or vice versa. However, you can use stablecoins, like USDT, which is tied to the US dollar.

What Are the Best Features of BingX?

The Best Features of BingX include Futures and Spot trading, Copy trading, Grid Trading Bots, Crypto Staking, and a P2P marketplace to help users complete transactions with one another. Now, let’s walk through the details of these features and how you can use them to maximize your crypto investment.

Spot and Futures Trading

In Spot markets, users can buy and sell cryptocurrencies for immediate delivery while enjoying profits or incurring losses directly from changes in the cryptocurrency value. On BingX, spot trading supports two types of orders: Market orders and Limit orders.

The first is a type of order in which you execute a buy or sell order immediately at the best price in the current market for fast trading. Meanwhile, Limit orders are a type of order where you can set the amount and the highest buy price or lowest sell price you can take.

When the market price matches your expectations, the system will automatically execute the order at the best price within the limit price range you set.

Here’s an example of how the two order types on BingX’s Spot Market work:

If you place a market order to buy ETH at the current market price, 3700 USDT. You can simply set the amount you want (e.g 100 USDT). The order will then be filled immediately when you initiate the transaction.

On the other hand, if you want to buy ETH at a lower price of 3500 USDT and the last price was 3700, you can choose the limit order and set the buy price at 3500 USDT. The limit order will be filled when the price of the coin drops to 3500 USDT. The same goes for selling crypto at a higher price than the current market price.

BingX also provides a Futures Trading Interface, which allows users to trade against the future price of a particular token while amplifying earnings through leverage.

For futures on BingX, you can either go long (buy) or short (sell) a trading pair to capitalize on the market price volatility. The trading platform provides two types of futures trading: Standard Futures and Perpetual Futures (USDT-M and Coin-M).

  1. Standard Futures Contracts

These contracts have a set expiration date on which a trader can agree to buy or sell a specific digital asset at a predetermined price. It is ideal for inexperienced traders; the trading interface is straightforward, intuitive, and easy to navigate.

Also, transactions on the Standard Futures Market are concluded quickly, making it perfect for investors who are currently on a tight budget.

  1. Perpetual Futures Contracts

Perpetual futures contracts do not have expiration dates, and you can hold them as long as you want to maximize your profits. BingX offers two margin modes in their perpetual futures market: USDT-margined (USDT-M) and Coin-margined (Coin-M). USDT-M.

That being said, the next question is, which one is best for you? Well, it depends on your experience and requirements, but here’s a guide on how to select between the Standard and Perpetual Futures trading on BingX.

Choose standard futures:

  • If you are new to futures.
  • If you need fast order execution.
  • If you prefer a more straightforward and faster trading process.
  • If you are interested in trading foreign currencies, international indices, and commodities.
  • If you would like to experiment with standard Coin-M futures.

Choose perpetual futures:

  • If you already have experience in trading futures.
  • If you invest large amounts of money in crypto.
  • If you need to trade without slippage when opening/closing positions.
  • If you need a more functional and sophisticated trading interface.
  • If you need greater market depth and higher liquidity.

Whichever one you decide on, BingX has an advanced slippage mechanism that initiates accurate stop losses to prevent you from losing a significant amount of money on trades.

Copy Trading

title: Solana Fires Back at Hardware Critics After Firedancer Validator Runs on a Tablet
summary:
Key Takeaways: On a tablet, Firedancer operated a validator on just one CPU core of Solana. Anatoly Yakovenko brought back the discussion about the hardware requirements of Solana for 2023.
The post Solana Fires Back at Hardware Critics After Firedancer Validator Runs on a Tablet appeared first on C...
content:
Key Takeaways:

  • On a tablet, Firedancer operated a validator on just one CPU core of Solana.
  • Anatoly Yakovenko brought back the discussion about the hardware requirements of Solana for 2023.
  • Production validators continue to need much more powerful hardware than the demo setup.

Solana co-founder Anatoly Yakovenko has revived an old decentralization debate after Firedancer developers demonstrated a live Solana validator running on tablet hardware. As a result, the test provided Yakovenko with a handy response to opposing arguments that Solana’s severe hardware needs restrict access to its network.

@TrustlessState @mryalamanchi @toghrulmaharram @mikebelshe We did it @TrustlessState; sol is money

— toly 🇺🇸 (@toly) November 15, 2026

  • Firedancer Puts a Solana Validator on Tablet Hardware
  • Yakovenko Turns Back to a 2023 Solana Debate
    • Firedancer Keeps Pushing Solana Toward Lighter Infrastructure
    • Production Solana Validators Still Need Much More Power

Firedancer Puts a Solana Validator on Tablet Hardware

Firedancer developer Ritchie Patel said a Solana mainnet full node ran on less than a single CPU core of a tablet while connected through 5G. Patel says the machine was able to compile and catch up to the chain tip and vote in about 10 seconds.

Solana mainnet full node running on less than a single CPU core of a tablet, networking via 5G.
10 seconds from nothing to caught up to chain tip and voting, including make -j, and initial snap sync.

— ripatel ✠ (@fd_ripatel) November 15, 2026

An independent blog post was devoted to this setup, as a live validator of Firedancer running using one CPU core and 20GB of RAM at the conference venue.

The demonstration took place at Block Zero, Solana’s validator and infrastructure event in London prior to the event itself, Solana Breakpoint 2026. Breakpoint is taking place at Olympia London Nov. 15 – 17 and is listed on the Solana schedule.

Read More: Solana Privacy Rings Go Live on Mainnet With Encrypted Transfers and Private DeFi

Yakovenko Turns Back to a 2023 Solana Debate

On Nov. 15th, Yakovenko gave a short reply to Bankless co-founder David Hoffman: “We did it” and “sol is money.”

The move originates back to January 2023, when Hoffman stated that reducing the blockchain’s hardware needs was crucial for its long-term resilience and accessibility.

At the time, Yakovenko admitted that mitigating the loads on Solana wasn’t a high priority for engineering work. But smaller hardware needs shouldn’t be seen as a cultural objective of blockchain networks, bolstered by Hoffman, who stated that it’s essential to keep the blockchains.

Nearly four years later, the Firedancer tablet test has provided Yakovenko with another definite answer.

Firedancer Keeps Pushing Solana Toward Lighter Infrastructure

Firedancer is an independent validator client for Solana to enhance performance and client diversity. In 2026, development has continued with continued progress having already made regular mainnet releases, and the ability to support ARM computers has been extended, thus going beyond x86 servers.

That makes the tablet demonstration more than a novelty. It demonstrates that software optimization can reduce the barrier to computing for a certain type of involvement in the Solana network.

However, the demo is not to be mistaken for the requirements necessary for running a production validator continuously while under network conditions.

Production Solana Validators Still Need Much More Power

At the moment, Anza recommends that validators have a minimum of 12 CPU cores, 256GB of RAM, and high-performance NVMe storage resources.

In addition, Anza calls for having a minimum of 2 Gbit/s (preferably 10 Gbit/s) symmetric internet connection for a staked validator. That’s a significant distance between those specs and a single-cored tablet with 20GB of memory.

Firedancer’s demo demonstrates what can be done technically in a controlled setting, however, and not what it can set as a new benchmark for production Solana validators.

Binance Global vs Binance US

The main difference between Binance Global and Binance US is that they are actually separate legal entities that follow different sets of rules. 

You can use the global Binance platform version if you live outside the United States, and it has the full list of over 500 coins and high-leverage futures. Also, on Binance Global, you can easily deposit and withdraw dozens of fiat currencies through bank transfers, credit or debit cards, and third‑party payment services. Binance US currently does not offer cash deposits or withdrawals (limited only). US users rely on ACH transfers and wire transfers for limited fiat support, and these may carry higher fees.

How Does Binance Work?

The Binance platform works by acting as a middleman that connects people who want to buy crypto with people who want to sell it. You can easily create an account, deposit funds, and then you use the exchange’s order book to place your trades. The system then uses its matching engine to pair your buy order with someone else’s sell order at the best possible price. Once the trade is complete, the assets are transferred between internal wallets.

You will notice that your account is divided into several sub-wallets based on what you are doing. You have a Spot Wallet for regular buying and holding, a Futures Wallet for leverage trading, and an Earn Wallet for your savings. You can move your money between these wallets instantly and for free. Basically, this structure helps you keep your different trading strategies organized so you don’t accidentally spend your long-term savings on a risky day trade.

What are the Pros and Cons of Binance Exchanges?

The pros of Binance include support for 500+ cryptocurrencies, competitive fees, advanced trading features, and strong security. While, the cons of the Binance exchange are the Binance US version for Americans with fewer features, overwhelming for beginners, and regulatory issues in the past.

Additionally, you can get 25% discounts if you use the Binance coin, BNB.
  • Multiple Trading Options and Order Types: Binance Exchange offers various trading options, including peer-to-peer, margin, and spot trading. The platform also has many order types, including limit order, market order, stop-limit order, stop market order, trailing stop order, and post-only order.
  • Robust Security and KYC: Binance enforces various security measures to protect users. For instance, the platform requires a strong password during registration and 2FA for all sensitive operations, such as logging in and transferring funds. They also encrypt data in storage and in transit to ensure that only you can access your personal information. Plus, in addition to these measures, Binance has a strict Know-Your-Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) policy.
  • Supports Fiat-to-crypto: Binance users can easily convert their local currency into digital assets. Some supported fiat on Binance include GBP, AUD, BRL, EUR, USD, ZAR, and RUS. You can make these fiat-to-crypto deposits using bank transfers, online banking, e-wallets, credit/debit cards, and Google/Apple Pay.

Disadvantages of Binance

  • Binance US is Limited: Binance US is a separate exchange operating under different regulations for Binance traders in the United States. Due to these strict regulations, the platform is more limited than the global exchange. It supports about 150 coins and 170+ trading pairs.
